deploy.description: Run the checks, build locally, and publish to Netlify
deploy.command: deno task ci && npm run build && netlify deploy --prod

tasks.check: deno check _config.ts _config/ sw.ts lib/ plugins/ jobs/ tools/ src/ platform/
tasks.test: deno test --allow-read --allow-write=_cache lib/ plugins/ jobs/ src/assets/scripts/

hooks.description: Install the pre-commit hook that runs the ci checks

ci.description: Formatting, lint, types, and tests, fastest first; the pre-commit hook and deploys run this
ci.command: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task test

tiles.description: Refresh the map tile extract from Protomaps
